previous_digest_file: 2026-09-26 - Weekly Portable Audio DSP GitHub Digest.md

top_repos.portability_reason: The reusable q_lib headers are separable from q_io audio-device, stream, and file code, but templates and memory behavior still need Cortex-M7 profiling.
top_repos.value_reason: Q's q_lib contributes reusable biquads, delay lines, envelopes, oscillators, and pitch utilities without requiring its q_io device layer.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with q_lib biquad, delay, envelope, and oscillator headers; replace q_io with fixed board callbacks and benchmark template size plus denormal behavior.
top_repos.note: Re-entry: updated - Q's q_lib contributes reusable biquads, delay lines, envelopes, oscillators, and pitch utilities without requiring its q_io device layer.
top_repos.summary: C++ Library for Audio Digital Signal Processing

top_repos.portability_reason: The core crates explicitly support no_std, fixed arrays, borrowed slices and fixed ring buffers; graph and allocation-backed adapters can be left out of the firmware feature set.
top_repos.value_reason: The dual MIT/Apache Rust crates provide no_std frames, sample conversion, fixed or borrowed ring buffers, interpolation, RMS/peak envelopes and allocation-free slice processing as independent modules.
top_repos.port_idea: Build only frame, sample, slice, ring_buffer and linear interpolation with --no-default-features; avoid dasp_graph and allocation-backed signal adapters, which are unnecessary in a fixed callback.
top_repos.note: Returning - The dual MIT/Apache Rust crates provide no_std frames, sample conversion, fixed or borrowed ring buffers, interpolation, RMS/peak envelopes and allocation-free slice processing as independent modules.
top_repos.summary: The fundamentals for Digital Audio Signal Processing. Formerly `sample`.

top_repos.portability_reason: A scalar hard-real-time C renderer exists, but eight operators and an 8x8 matrix per voice are expensive, while the optimized NEON code targets ARMv7/8 rather than Cortex-M7.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT C core supplies eight operators, an arbitrary 8x8 modulation matrix, per-operator envelopes, carrier selection and hard-real-time rendering with scalar and ARM NEON paths.
top_repos.port_idea: Start from the scalar C renderer with one to four voices and four operators, keep its 32-sample control updates, then benchmark whether Teensy 4 M7 scalar throughput makes the ARMv7 NEON path unnecessary.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT C core supplies eight operators, an arbitrary 8x8 modulation matrix, per-operator envelopes, carrier selection and hard-real-time rendering with scalar and ARM NEON paths.
top_repos.summary: A C library which implements an FM synthesizer

top_repos.portability_reason: The C++11 headers are host-independent, but delay and spectral classes own dynamic storage at setup; firmware should select small modules and replace those buffers with bounded caller-owned memory.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT C++11 headers combine fractional/multi-tap delay, cubic curves, envelope utilities, multirate helpers, FFT/STFT and spectral-processing primitives behind small independent includes.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with delay.h plus envelopes.h, provide caller-owned fixed storage for the delay, and defer FFT/spectral modules until SRAM and cycle budgets are measured.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT C++11 headers combine fractional/multi-tap delay, cubic curves, envelope utilities, multirate helpers, FFT/STFT and spectral-processing primitives behind small independent includes.
top_repos.summary: GitHub mirror of Signalsmith Audio's C++ DSP support library

top_repos.portability_reason: Compile-time wdft trees avoid runtime topology allocation and XSIMD is optional, but nonlinear Omega evaluation and complex R-type circuits require deliberate model and approximation choices.
top_repos.value_reason: The BSD C++14 headers provide compile-time wave-digital circuit trees, diode and diode-pair nonlinearities, R-type adaptors and selectable Wright-Omega approximations used by real pedal models.
top_repos.port_idea: Instantiate one fixed wdft diode clipper or tone stack without XSIMD, choose a lower-order Omega approximation if needed, and update component impedances only at control rate.
top_repos.note: Returning - The BSD C++14 headers provide compile-time wave-digital circuit trees, diode and diode-pair nonlinearities, R-type adaptors and selectable Wright-Omega approximations used by real pedal models.
top_repos.summary: Chowdhury DSP Wave Digital Filters Library

top_repos.portability_reason: Individual C89 init/tick kernels are small and self-contained, but the repository's default graph/interpreter layer allocates and must be excluded in favor of selected caller-owned modules.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT/Unlicense literate toolkit tangles self-contained C89 kernels and includes concrete talkbox, PADsynth, Verbity reverb and noise modules that can be extracted independently of its LIL/Graforge host.
top_repos.port_idea: Tangle or copy one sk_* init/tick kernel, move setup allocation into caller-owned state, and exclude the LIL interpreter, graph allocator and FFT-based modules from the first firmware build.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT/Unlicense literate toolkit tangles self-contained C89 kernels and includes concrete talkbox, PADsynth, Verbity reverb and noise modules that can be extracted independently of its LIL/Graforge host.
top_repos.summary: A collection of highly portable audio DSP algorithms, written in ANSI C using literate programming.

top_repos.portability_reason: The runtime is one MIT header with fixed pole/state counts; only the constructor's fractional-step vector should become build-time or fixed-capacity storage.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT single header implements an 11th-order elliptic BLEP for step, impulse and slope discontinuities, including optional all-pass phase compensation and predesigned coefficients.
top_repos.port_idea: Generate the fractional-step pole table at build time or replace its setup vector with a fixed array, then use the residue path for one saw/pulse oscillator and profile the eight complex states.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT single header implements an 11th-order elliptic BLEP for step, impulse and slope discontinuities, including optional all-pass phase compensation and predesigned coefficients.
top_repos.summary: Code to accompany the ADC24 talk

top_repos.portability_reason: Individual header models keep allocation in prepare(), but C++20, dynamic setup storage, calibration work, and optional heavyweight processors require a deliberately small firmware subset.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT, header-only C++20 library exposes setup-thread-allocated tape, Koren triode/tone-stack, and Jiles-Atherton transformer models and ships an exceptions-free embedded profile.
top_repos.port_idea: Port one TransformerModel or TubePreamp block, preallocate its channel state, start at 1x oversampling, and leave convolution, phase-vocoder, and 64-grain processors out of the firmware build.
top_repos.note: Re-entry: updated - The MIT, header-only C++20 library exposes setup-thread-allocated tape, Koren triode/tone-stack, and Jiles-Atherton transformer models and ships an exceptions-free embedded profile.
top_repos.summary: Header-only audio DSP framework in pure C++20, zero dependencies. 100+ real-time processors, physical analog models, EBU R128 metering. One codebase for cross-platform audio apps - desktop, mobile, WebAssembly, embedded - and VST3/CLAP/AU plugins.

top_repos.portability_reason: The pure-C engine and host boundary are unusually clean, but the full four-engine, sampler, 15-effect and oversampling configuration must be reduced to a fixed MCU build.
top_repos.value_reason: Its MIT pure-C engine separates subtractive, four-operator FM, wavetable and sampler voices from CLAP/VST3/ImGui hosts, with atomic parameters, SPSC command queues and zero allocation in the audio path.
top_repos.port_idea: Compile only src/engine plus synth_api, cap polyphony and effect count, replace desktop atomics where unnecessary, and omit sampler/file recording unless external storage is planned.
top_repos.note: Returning - Its MIT pure-C engine separates subtractive, four-operator FM, wavetable and sampler voices from CLAP/VST3/ImGui hosts, with atomic parameters, SPSC command queues and zero allocation in the audio path.
top_repos.summary: Multi-engine synthesizer (subtractive/FM/wavetable) — CLAP/VST3 plugin + standalone. Pure C, real-time safe.

top_repos.portability_reason: The static Faust filter bank is directly generatable, but six third-order Cauer bands and reconstruction variants need a reduced static configuration and Cortex-M7 profiling.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT Faust sources implement six-band Regalia-Mitra complementary banks from third-order Cauer prototypes, with static/dynamic edges and sum-versus-synthesis reconstruction variants.
top_repos.port_idea: Generate the static sum-reconstruction variant first, reduce the six-band bank if needed, and keep edge-frequency changes at control rate; avoid the dynamic synthesis bank until CPU profiling passes.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT Faust sources implement six-band Regalia-Mitra complementary banks from third-order Cauer prototypes, with static/dynamic edges and sum-versus-synthesis reconstruction variants.
top_repos.summary: Multi-Band Stereophony is a simple multi-band effect implemented in FAUST that down-mixes a stereo signal separately per frequency band.
